title: Recipe file (data/recipes/<id>.json, one recipe per file)
description: Something cooked at the hearth at the hero's home (GDD §6, TECH_DESIGN §18): what it needs and what it makes. Every item id must be in data/items. The hearth lists every recipe the hero knows; adding one needs no code.

taught.description: Not known from the start: the hearth lists it only once the effect teach_recipe has taught it (a villager's conversation).

needs.description: What is used up, each with how many.
